articles.title: Healthy snacking race intensifies across Asia-Pacific
articles.excerpt: Five finalists are headed to a regional industry challenge as food innovators focus on nutrition, taste and commercial potential.
articles.summary: The Healthy Snacks Challenge has selected five finalists representing new approaches to functional ingredients, fermentation and plant-based foods. The finalists are due to participate in a Singapore development event in January 2027.

articles.title: Fiji announces review of food safety legislation
articles.excerpt: The government has approved a review of existing food safety rules in a move aimed at stronger public-health protection.
articles.summary: According to Food Safety News, Fiji has announced plans to examine its Food Safety Act 2003 and associated laws. The report describes the review as part of efforts to update consumer protection and food safety oversight.

articles.title: Raw-milk cheese outbreak renews debate over dairy food safety
articles.excerpt: A reported Yersinia outbreak highlights the importance of safe dairy production and handling practices.
articles.summary: Food Safety News has covered a Yersinia outbreak associated with raw-milk cheese. The case is a reminder that foodborne risks require close attention from producers, retailers and public-health officials. Readers should consult the source for the full investigation and latest advice.

articles.title: Migration is reshaping farming and farmland demand in Baitadi
articles.excerpt: A November report shows how shifting populations are affecting land values and the future of agricultural production.
articles.summary: The Kathmandu Post describes changing demand for farmland in Baitadi as residents relocate to cities and the Tarai. The report notes that some agricultural land is becoming harder to sell and younger workers are leaving farming areas.
